title: Star Wars - The New Droid Army

match.zip: Star Wars - The New Droid Army.zip

sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Health, Force
Luke Skywalker, between A New Hope and Empire, stops a new droid army
Health bar and Force meter; Force powers are learned as you go

Force powers learned through the game; lightsaber
Lightsaber combos and blocking; Force powers include push, jump and others gained by story
Use the Force meter for special moves; it refills over time

Droid army forces
Droids dominate the enemy roster; blasters are deflected by blocking with the saber
Bosses close each area; learn their attack patterns, then counter

Cloud City and other locations
Areas from the ROM's level list include the processing plant, the Metellos outskirts and the factory core (several parts)

Health
Health and Force refills from crates and defeated enemies

Hidden items
Hidden items in side passages of the factory and outskirts levels

Missions
Story missions in order up to the droid factory
Force powers grow with the story
